rawFindings.title: Population logic no longer adds all original values to rawIds
rawFindings.explanation: The line adding the original 'ret' value to 'rawIds' during population was removed. This line is critical because it tracks all original values for mapping query results back to the correct positions. Omitting this line means the population assignment may be incomplete or incorrectly ordered, leading to wrong or missing populated documents.
rawFindings.suggestion: Reinstate the line 'rawIds.push(ret);' within the population function to ensure all original values are tracked properly.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: When populating references on documents with multiple values, some populated documents may be missing or incorrectly assigned because 'rawIds' no longer contains all original path values, breaking the population mapping.
